name: Haldiram's Soan Papdi (indian Sweets)
ingredients: Refined Sugar, Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Refined Palmolein Oil, Bengal Gram Flour (Besan), Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (Vanaspati), Liquid Glucose, Cardamom, Almond & Pistachio Nuts. Allergen: Contains Almonds, Pistachios & Wheat May Contains Coconut, Cashew, Milk, Soy, Peanut & Sesame Seed.
